value.description:
Patients undergo breast conserving surgery.
Patients receive adjuvant chemotherapy at the physician's discretion.
Patients receiving chemotherapy will start treatment within 12 weeks following surgery.
Patients receive radiation therapy within 8 weeks following the last dose of chemotherapy or within 10 weeks following surgery if not receiving chemotherapy.
Patients receive endocrine therapy at the physician's discretion.
Patient observation will occur every 6 months until 5 years after the end of radiation therapy.
